digest.component_or_area: review-bot container Bedrock access via instance role
propositions: The review-bot container needs Bedrock access via the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role but the role currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt, not Bedrock permissions

The Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream, not bedrock:Converse and bedrock:ConverseStream (verified by real instance-role call, not by IAM simulator alone)
IMDS is reachable from containers on the host via IMDSv2 token PUT (AC1 probe), enabling instance-profile credential discovery without raising the metadata hop-limit contingency
A scoped inline policy must be added to iam_s7.tf without modifying iam.tf, following the established single-owner contract and iam_s2.tf/iam_s4a.tf pattern

The Bedrock grant scope must be restricted to anthropic.claude foundation models and *.anthropic.claude inference profiles with region wildcards, and must be validated by real Converse calls from the scoped role, not by simulator-only testing under a wildcard-holding identity
